nodes.label: Logo v1 — Clean Transparent Badge (PNG)
nodes.description: PNG with transparent background (checkerboard visible). Same core flat cartoon badge design as logo.png: circular crimson red badge, gold ring border, bold white uppercase 'CHICKEN' at top arc and 'TIME' at bottom arc, central white analog clock face with black numerals and hands, red second hand showing near midnight/noon. Cartoon white rooster in chef's hat to the right. Black ribbon banner beneath reads 'PIRI PIRI & PERFECTION' in gold uppercase text. Transparent background makes this suited for overlay on any surface.
